title: Range-compatible homomorphisms on Hermitian matrices
summary: Let $\mathbb{D}$ be a division ring with an involution $x \mapsto x^\star$, and $n \geq 2$ be an integer. Denote by $\mathcal{H}_n(\mathbb{D})$ the set of all $n$-by-$n$ Hermitian matrices with entries in $\mathbb{D}$, and by $\mathcal{A}\mathcal{H}_n(\mathbb{D})$ the set of all matrices $A-A^\star$ with $A \in \mathcal{M}_n(\mathbb{D})$. Here, we give a complete solution to the following problem: Determine all group homomorphisms from $\mathcal{H}_n(\mathbb{D})$ to $\mathbb{D}^n$ (respectively, from $\mathcal{A}\mathcal{H}_n(\mathbb{D})$ to $\mathbb{D}^n$ unless $(-)^\star$ is the identity)…
